mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} AND media_type = #{mediaType} AND link_variant = #{linkVariant}
SELECT * FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} AND media_type = #{mediaType} AND link_variant = #{linkVariant} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY connection_id, drama_id, external_code ) grouped

SELECT g.id, l.provider_id, p.provider_name, l.drama_id, d.title AS drama_title, l.campaign_name, l.external_code, l.created_at, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN l.media_type END AS media_type, g.landing_url, g.one_link_url, (g.media_type_count > 1) AS analytics_conflict, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.click_count, 0) END AS click_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.attributed_user_count, 0) END AS attributed_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.new_registered_user_count, 0) END AS new_registered_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.new_paid_user_count, 0) END AS new_paid_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.new_member_user_count, 0) END AS new_member_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.paid_user_count, 0) END AS paid_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.order_count, 0) END AS order_count FROM ( SELECT MIN(l.id) AS id, l.user_id, l.connection_id, l.drama_id, l.external_code, COUNT(DISTINCT l.media_type) AS media_type_count, MAX(CASE WHEN l.link_variant = 'LANDING' THEN l.share_url END) AS landing_url, MAX(CASE WHEN l.link_variant = 'ONELINK' THEN l.share_url END) AS one_link_url FROM promotion_link l WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY l.user_id, l.connection_id, l.drama_id, l.external_code ) g JOIN promotion_link l ON l.id = g.id LEFT JOIN short_drama_provider p ON p.id = l.provider_id LEFT JOIN provider_drama d ON d.id = l.drama_id LEFT JOIN short_drama_connection c ON c.id = l.connection_id LEFT JOIN promotion_user u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pid, custom_params, book_id, code, SUM(click_count) AS click_count, SUM(attributed_user_count) AS attributed_user_count, SUM(new_registered_user_count) AS new_registered_user_count, SUM(new_paid_user_count) AS new_paid_user_count, SUM(new_member_user_count) AS new_member_user_count, SUM(paid_user_count) AS paid_user_count, SUM(order_count) AS order_count FROM promotion_analytical_report GROUP BY pid, custom_params, book_id, code ) r ON r.code = g.external_code AND r.pid = c.partner_id AND r.book_id = d.external_drama_id AND r.custom_params = u.user_no ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM promotion_link l JOIN promotion_user u ON u.id = l.user_id
GROUP BY l.user_id, l.connection_id, l.drama_id, l.external_code ) grouped

SELECT g.id, u.user_no, u.nickname, u.real_name, l.provider_id, p.provider_name, l.drama_id, d.title AS drama_title, l.campaign_name, l.external_code, l.created_at, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN l.media_type END AS media_type, g.landing_url, g.one_link_url, (g.media_type_count > 1) AS analytics_conflict, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.click_count, 0) END AS click_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.attributed_user_count, 0) END AS attributed_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.new_registered_user_count, 0) END AS new_registered_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.new_paid_user_count, 0) END AS new_paid_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.new_member_user_count, 0) END AS new_member_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.paid_user_count, 0) END AS paid_user_count, CASE WHEN g.media_type_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(r.order_count, 0) END AS order_count FROM ( SELECT MIN(l.id) AS id, l.user_id, l.connection_id, l.drama_id, l.external_code, COUNT(DISTINCT l.media_type) AS media_type_count, MAX(CASE WHEN l.link_variant = 'LANDING' THEN l.share_url END) AS landing_url, MAX(CASE WHEN l.link_variant = 'ONELINK' THEN l.share_url END) AS one_link_url FROM promotion_link l JOIN promotion_user u ON u.id = l.user_id
GROUP BY l.user_id, l.connection_id, l.drama_id, l.external_code ) g JOIN promotion_link l ON l.id = g.id JOIN promotion_user u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN short_drama_provider p ON p.id = l.provider_id LEFT JOIN provider_drama d ON d.id = l.drama_id LEFT JOIN short_drama_connection c ON c.id = l.connection_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pid, custom_params, book_id, code, SUM(click_count) AS click_count, SUM(attributed_user_count) AS attributed_user_count, SUM(new_registered_user_count) AS new_registered_user_count, SUM(new_paid_user_count) AS new_paid_user_count, SUM(new_member_user_count) AS new_member_user_count, SUM(paid_user_count) AS paid_user_count, SUM(order_count) AS order_count FROM promotion_analytical_report GROUP BY pid, custom_params, book_id, code ) r ON r.code = g.external_code AND r.pid = c.partner_id AND r.book_id = d.external_drama_id AND r.custom_params = u.user_no ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_link (user_id, provider_id, connection_id, drama_id, batch_no, media_type, link_variant, request_key, tracking_no, campaign_name, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{providerId}, #{connectionId}, #{dramaId}, #{batchNo}, #{mediaType}, #{linkVariant}, #{requestKey}, #{trackingNo}, #{campaignName}, #{status})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM promotion_link WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_link SET status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE promotion_link SET status = #{status}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
